definitions.explicit_dates: Dates written in the question are used as written. Any other relative phrase is unsupported and must be declined rather than guessed.
definitions.last_night: For sleep: the local day before today, because sleep intervals are assigned to the day they start (the evening before counts as that day's sleep).
definitions.last_week: The previous calendar week, Monday through Sunday, inclusive.
definitions.past_30_days: The thirty local days ending today, inclusive of today.
definitions.past_7_days: The seven local days ending today, inclusive of today.
definitions.previous_30_days: The thirty local days immediately before the past 30 days.
definitions.previous_7_days: The seven local days immediately before the past 7 days.
definitions.this_week: Monday of the current week through today, inclusive.
definitions.three_weeks_ago: The calendar week three weeks before the current week, Monday to Sunday.
definitions.timezone: All dates use the request timezone; the server injects it into every tool call.
definitions.today: The current local date in the request timezone (or the evaluation override).
